notes.title: Controller support and Bonus Level!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41614885/4400af2e4750bd739709766ab93f8a90fb826dc4.png[/img]As noted in the community messages I added controller support. All should be good to go but please report any bugs as supporting all the different types of hardware out there can be super tricky.

Not long ago I also got returned ownership of the intellectual properties and characters I created for the Boo Bunny Plague games, so in order to celebrate this I added a bonus level  with a Boo Bunny Plague theme,

Enjoy the controller support, enjoy Boo, let me know about any bugs and I'll look more into adding leaderboards for you guys as requested. 

As always, thank you all so much for playing.

notes.title: Critical fix for GPU usage issue
notes.notes: A curator review has pointed out a critical issue with GPU usage that should now be corrected. Big thanks to the Lewd Gamer curator team for the heads up.

notes.title: Ball amount on failure bug corrected.
notes.notes: If you fail a level by losing all 5 balls the game will no longer reset and only give you 2 balls remaining. It will now give you all 5. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Small content/fix update!
notes.notes:
Thank you guys so much for playing my game. I appreciate all the feedback and support! I have made some adjustments and fixes based on feedback and testing.
• Level 3(Ollie the Mime) is now not so weirdly configured
• Some sounds were edited and volumes adjusted.

Once again, thank you guys for playing the game. Everything in it was hand drawn, the music is all made by me, coded by me, etc... it was a passion project that took me much longer than it should have. It means the world to me that you even gave it the time of day.
